zh.title: 电脑使用历史（Computer History）
zh.summary: 启用 Chronicle 边车进程，被动记录屏幕上下文形成记忆。
zh.note: ChatGPT 桌面端设置里的「Computer History」即此旗标；更早的内部代号是 telepathy（见 legacy_aliases）。

en.title: Computer History
en.summary: Enables the Chronicle sidecar that passively captures screen context into memories.
en.note: This is the flag behind “Computer History” in the ChatGPT desktop app; its earlier internal codename was telepathy (see legacy_aliases).
